subject: BrightGrid marketplace onboarding & sell-with evidence — placement asks
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie@brightgrid.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dina Shah <dina@brightgrid.com>; Sam Cohen <sam.cohen@aws-partner.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGrid -> Redwood marketplace: initial evidence bundle and ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. We have a quick list of asks from our marketplace team to get BrightGrid listed as a Sell-With partner on AWS and GCP. Can you confirm who on Redwood can own the following items and an ETA?

- Co-sell evidence checklist (billing, metering, entitlement mapping) — we need sample files and contact.
- Marketplace placement ask: requesting category visibility in "Data + AI -> Inference" and a featured tile for two weeks post-launch.
- Technical test account for AWS private offer & GCP listing verification (sandbox credentials).
- Joint press blurb review and logo usage.

I attached a draft SLA and our internal checklist so you can see what the cloud teams want. Ideally we'd like these wrapped up by next Thu (9/23) to hit AWS co-sell planning for Oct.

Appreciate a quick owner + ETA so we can sync with Sam on the AWS side.

Best,
Julie
Head of Partnerships, BrightGrid

Attachments: BrightGrid_SLA_Draft.pdf (PDF, 45KB), co-sell-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 18KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightGrid -> Redwood marketplace: initial evidence bundle and ask

Hi Julie — thanks for the clear list and the attachments. Short answer: we can hit most of this, but want to align internal owners and the sequencing. Quick plan below (owners + ETA):

- Co-sell evidence checklist: Ben Carter will own assembling the evidence pack (metering, sample invoices, entitlement mapping). ETA: 9/21 for a first pass.
- Marketplace placement ask: Vivek will take the cat/tile request to Catalog Ops and push for the featured tile. ETA: placement decision by 9/24 (depends on catalog window).
- Technical test account: We can provision a sandbox for AWS private offers and GCP listing validation. I will coordinate; ETA: credentials by 9/18.
- Press blurb: I will review with our comms brief and loop Legal for logo terms. ETA: 9/20.

I'll loop Olga for the evidence handoff because she usually owns the listing evidence bundles. Ben/Olga/Vivek — please confirm you can take the items above. Julie, can you confirm the exact metering SKU you want mapped and the preferred contact at AWS (Sam was CC'd)?

Karthik
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

[Sent from Redwood Inference — Redwood Inference helps engineers run LLM inference across cloud/private deployments]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightGrid -> Redwood marketplace: initial evidence bundle and ask

Karthik / team — I can assemble the evidence pack. Quick notes from a tech/evidence perspective:

- Metering: we need BrightGrid to confirm how they expect usage reported (per-token vs compute-hour bundling). If they want per-token mapping to a Redwood SKU we need a sample billing export — Julie, can you send a two-week sample?
- Entitlement: Most marketplaces expect an "entitlement token" pattern. We support private-link/demo keys. For AWS private offers we need the partner to accept the reseller terms; I can prep the mapping doc.
- Test accounts: please avoid sharing PROD keys; I will create limited-scope test credentials.

I'll draft the evidence checklist into our workbook and drop it into the Drive folder Karthik linked. Targeting 9/21 for the evidence zip.

—Ben
Senior Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@brightgrid.com>, Sam Cohen <sam.cohen@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightGrid -> Redwood marketplace: initial evidence bundle and ask

Julie / Sam — quick status update and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Evidence pack: Ben will upload the initial evidence workbook and sample metering mapping into the shared Drive by EOD 9/21. Action: BrightGrid to provide two-week billing sample and preferred SKU mapping by 9/18.
2) Sandbox credentials: We will provision limited AWS/GCP test accounts for BrightGrid by 9/18. Ben will send the access notes.
3) Catalog placement: Vivek has flagged the featured tile request with Catalog Ops. Catalog will confirm if the 10/04 content window is available; provisional ETA 9/24.
4) Legal/press: Karthik will circulate logo/usage terms; BrightGrid to send final logo files.

Sam — if AWS needs anything specific (co-sell entitlement pattern or private-offer meta) let us know and we will incorporate in the evidence pack.

Julie — short ask: reply-all with the billing sample and the contact at your finance team so Ben can proceed. Once we have that, we're on track to meet the catalog window.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced earlier: BrightGrid_SLA_Draft.pdf, co-sell-evidence-checklist.xlsx
